text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Summer is coming! I made Taiki promise me 
before she left for France! I told her she 
absolutely has to win!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We can't afford to fall behind either! 
This summer, I'll hone my speed and 
surpass Taiki!
